response.justification: Bogdan has genuine high-throughput distributed systems experience (Sociomantic/Dunnhumby handling millions of requests/sec) and is currently in a Staff Software Engineer role doing hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling work, which aligns well with the AI-native mindset the role demands. However, the resume shows no evidence of Python experience despite it being an explicit must-have, and there's little explicit signal around stakeholder management, formal on-call rotations, or agile ceremony participation, making this a partial fit that needs technical validation.
strengths: Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems experience at scale (millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Current hands-on work building AI-agent infrastructure, MCP generators and agentic frameworks
Broad polyglot systems-thinking background spanning web, embedded, mobile and backend across many companies
concerns: No mention of Python anywhere in skills or project history, despite it being a core must-have
No explicit evidence of stakeholder management, cross-functional coordination, or on-call/incident response ownership
History of frequent job changes (many roles under 2 years) raises questions about depth of ownership in each role
